title: The projective-line adjunction for towers
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and an arbitrary scheme $S$ on which $\ell$ is invertible. Use the varying-coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers] and their ordinary derived category [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. For a scheme $T$ over $S$, write $\mathscr C^+(T)$ for the full subcategory of $D^+(\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E))$ whose level $n$, for every $n\geq1$, is in the essential image of $\nu_T^*:D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^n)\to D^+(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^n)$; this means there exists an etale-origin witness as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. Write $\mathbf P^1_T=\mathbf P(\{0,1\};T)$ as in [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. Let $\Delta:\mathbf P^1_S\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^1_S\times_S\mathbf P^1_S$ be the diagonal.

Let $q:\mathbf P^1_S\to S$, and let $p_1,p_2:\mathbf P^1_S\times_S\mathbf P^1_S\to\mathbf P^1_S$
be the projections. Define, for $K_\bullet\in\mathscr C^+(S)$ and
$M_\bullet\in\mathscr C^+(\mathbf P^1_S)$,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\varepsilon_\bullet(K_\bullet):\ &Rq_{*,\bullet}(q_\bullet^*K_\bullet(1)[2])
\simeq K_\bullet\otimes^{\mathbf L}Rq_{*,\bullet}(\mathcal O_{E,\mathbf P^1_S}/\ell^\bullet)(1)[2]
\xrightarrow{\ \mathrm{id}\otimes\operatorname{Tr}_{q,\bullet}\ }K_\bullet,\\
\eta_\bullet(M_\bullet):\ &M_\bullet\simeq Rp_{2*,\bullet}\Delta_*M_\bullet
\xrightarrow{\ Rp_{2*,\bullet}(\delta_\bullet\otimes p_1^*M_\bullet)\ }
Rp_{2*,\bullet}p_1^*M_\bullet(1)[2]\simeq q_\bullet^*Rq_{*,\bullet}M_\bullet(1)[2],
\end{aligned}
$$

with $\operatorname{Tr}_{q,\bullet}$ and $\delta_\bullet$ from [det-sp-tower-classes].
Then $\eta_\bullet$ and $\varepsilon_\bullet$ are the unit and counit of an
adjunction $Rq_{*,\bullet}\dashv q_\bullet^*(-)(1)[2]$ between $\mathscr C^+(\mathbf P^1_S)$ and $\mathscr C^+(S)$, whose
evaluation at level $n$ is the finite projective-line adjunction. In the standing scheme setting [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], where $S$ is separated and of finite type over a field of positive characteristic different from $\ell$, this adjunction restricts to the full subcategories of uniformly bounded constructible finite-Tor towers [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers].

proof.text: Obtain Maps d and the canonical EtaleOriginComparisonsWithLine h, giving natural eta and epsilon on the prescribed full domains.

Obtain normalized kernel splitting k and hk. Identify the inverse-exchange projection traces with k.trace using the trace identification bridge. Then diagonalScalar h a = k.scalar a = identity for each Boolean projection.

Apply the tower triangle factorization. Tensor of identity with identity is identity by functor.map_id, and the scalar unitors cancel. Hence both triangles are identities on the actual tower-derived categories.

Use the existing etaTransformation and epsilonTransformation as the adjunction unit and counit. The full-subcategory hom extensionality transfers the actual ambient triangle equalities. This is the adjunction record; both specified component equations are reflexive.

For each positive level use finite-adjunction assembly from reflected single-level triangles and normalized formula comparisons. Choose its finite map data, adjunction and two component equations to fill the finite fields of AdjunctionData.

Use the uniform-domain transport theorem in presentation coordinates to fill constructible_restriction. This is the original uniform-domain theorem transported by realization counits with unchanged bounds.
